title: Spring Boot
explain: Spring Boot starts a production-ready web application with very little setup. `@SpringBootApplication` turns on auto-configuration, and `@RestController` with `@GetMapping` maps a URL to a method that returns the response body. Add the `spring-boot-starter-web` dependency and run the `main` method to get a server on port 8080.
exercise: Generate a project at start.spring.io with the Web dependency, paste this in, run it, and open `/hello?name=Ada`.
tip: Keep your main class in the top-level package. Spring scans only that package and the ones below it, so classes outside it are not picked up.
